en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The course will deepen students' knowledge and skills in the field of cyber security and enable them to apply the knowledge in practice.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Common principles of ensuring security and availability of digital assets (allowance 2/2) a.evaluation of digital assets, risks and their assessment and eliminationb.security policiesc.physical and organizational protection of IT infrastructure2.Cryptography and crypto analysis (allowance 2/2) a.symmetrical and asymmetrical algorithmsb.hash functionsc.security techniques based on cryptographic mechanisms3.Authentication, authorization, accounting (allowance 2/2) a.password policies, password management, multi-factor authenticationb.user accounts, groups, permissionsc.centralized authentication/authorization/accountingd.single-sign on4.Protection of servers and data (allowance 2/2) a.application of user roles and permissions in operating systemsb.event audit (eg. SELinux)c.data backupd.disk encryption5.Management and monitoring of services and networks (allowance 2/2) a.server monitoring goalsb.metrics for service monitoringc.monitoring Toolsd.logging and syslog server6.Securing communication of services (allowance 2/2) a.PKI, certificates, encrypted communicationb.digital signaturec.high availability (anycast, DNS, CDN)7.Tools for protection of endpoints (allowance 2/4) a.antivirus, antimalware, etc.b.personal firewall and its potentialc.unified endpoint managementd.control of endpoints access to the network (network admission)8.Methods of network infrastructure protection (allowance 4/8) a.securing of IP protocol (against IP spoofing, etc.)b.network segmentation, VLANc.network firewalls, IPS, etc.d.NGFW, web proxye.VPN (site-to-site, remote access)9.Security of wireless communication (allowance 2/2) a.PSK vs. enterprise (IEEE 802.1x protocol)b.wireless controllers and their managementc.monitoring of radio spectrum, rogue AP detectiond.specifics of IoT networks10.Special tools for securing networks (allowance 2/2) a.honeypots and their possibilities and limitationsb.principle and purpose of sandboxingc.server virtualization for high availability11.Legislation framework of cybersecurity (allowance 2/0) a.personal data – definition of the term, methods of protection.b.Cybersecurity law, GDPR, NIS2, …c.cybersecurity at the level of an organization and country12.CSIRT and CERT teams, SOC centers and their competencies (allowance 2/0) a.definition of CSIRT and CERT, difference from SOCb.role and position of CSIRT and SOC in organizationsc.enforcing of security policy principles and its tools.13.Social engineering (allowance 2/0) a.methods of social engineering (phishing, pharming, …)b.protection principlesc.security training
